register.subtitle: Welcome to our platform!
register.intro: Thanks for signing up with AutoSouk! We're excited to have you on board. To complete your registration and secure your account, please verify your email address by clicking the button below.

forgot_password.subject: Password reset request for your account
forgot_password.title: Reset Your Password
forgot_password.subtitle: Password Reset Request
forgot_password.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your AutoSouk account. If you made this request, click the button below to create a new password.
forgot_password.security_text: If you believe this request was made in error or by someone else, please ignore this email and consider changing your password immediately through your account settings.
forgot_password.not_requested_text: If you didn't request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email. Your password will remain unchanged, and no further action is required.
forgot_password.support_text: Need help or have security concerns? Contact our support team immediately at
